newsitem.title: UK: "Association" between salmonella and Milumil - UK.
newsitem.headline: "Association" between salmonella and Milumil - UK.

text.p: Britain's Department of Health said tests had shown an "association" between salmonella anatum and Milumil baby milk powder, withdrawn from sale last month.

A spokeswoman said on Tuesday that at a meeting last Friday "the company accepted that the epidemiological evidence and microbiological analysis of cases demonstrated an association between salmonella anatum in infants and Milumil."
"The Department of Health and the company have been discussing what steps need to be taken next, with the aim of safely reintroducing the product." Milumil is made by Dutch food group Nutricia NV.
